responsibility: This tutorial example shows the C++ binding style for building explicit control flow in libgccjit. It creates a loop_test function using locals, named blocks, comparison and arithmetic operators, jumps, and a return to model a sum-of-squares loop, then compiles and runs it. It serves as the C++ counterpart to the C CFG example, emphasizing wrapper-based block and expression construction.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/docs/examples/tut03-sum-of-squares.c, this same-stem control-flow tutorial uses the C++ wrapper API, representing the same loop and CFG with gccjit classes and operator-style expressions.
